terms.meaning: Numbers joined by operations. Its value is the number it works out to. 3 × 4 is an expression with value 12.
A part of an expression separated by + signs, after writing each subtraction as adding a negative. 23 − 2 × 4 has terms 23 and −2 × 4.

items.name: Terms
items.formula: Work out each term, then add

items.name: Multiplying a bracket
items.formula: a × (b + c) = a × b + a × c

items.name: Comparing two sums
items.example: 1023 + 125 and 1022 + 128: −1 and +3 is a net +2, so the second is larger.

items.name: Keeping a difference the same
items.formula: Change both numbers by the same amount

mistakes.text: Do not just work from left to right. 30 + 5 × 4 = 30 + 20 = 50, not 35 × 4 = 140.
A minus before a bracket changes every sign inside. 500 − (250 − 100) is 350, not 150.
Subtraction cannot be swapped by itself: 9 − 4 is not 4 − 9. Swap terms with their signs: 9 + (−4) = (−4) + 9.
Multiply every term in the bracket. 4 × (10 + 3) is 52, not 43.
